extension.news:
3.0.3 - Fix: a widget picked from a library node takes its type from the node, so add-on nodes are no longer mistyped
3.0.2 - Add: skins can restyle the DialogSelect pickers with a skinshortcuts-picker property and ListItem metadata - Add: skins can define the management dialog context menu, the buttons it lists and where it opens - Add: skins can retire a widget, background or property in an overrides block and point saved menus at its replacement - Add: icon overrides name a source folder, so a skin's own icons replace the Kodi defaults, packed or loose - Add: a rename attribute on a widget picker button prompts for a custom widget label - Add: a global submenuPath element, plus a submenuPath property on menu items for their widget submenu - Add: show a source as a library view instead of files, with a sort order - Fix: program add-ons that expose plugin content are browsable in the content picker - Fix: property conditions combine + and | as Kodi does, and an expression reference expands as a single term - Fix: the includes file is written with unix line endings on every platform - Fix: the skin reloads only when a rebuild changes the includes - Fix: the picker keeps its place when it reopens instead of jumping back to the current selection - Fix: backgrounds that open a browse or playlist dialog get the same folder arrow as groups
